page.notes: The blot over the "m" of "siumprimi" in the first line hides letters; the first word is marked illegible. The page number is printed as "51" with a blurred final digit; the reading "51" is uncertain. "præsertin" is probably a printing error for "præsertim" and is left as printed. "Dallæi" and "Dallæani" are kept as printed. A blot before "2." in the line "2. seculo" is ink, not a mark, and is not transcribed. The specks in the left margin are not text. The "X." in the right margin is a section marker and is kept as a note.
